nodes.label: MUSE: A Full-Text Cross-Domain Knowledge Base of Scientific Problems, Solutions, and Rationales
nodes.author: Tsofia Cohen, Tom Hope

nodes.label: Problem–Solution–Rationale Extraction
nodes.rationale: Core task: extract fine-grained technical problem-solving structures from full-text scientific papers; captures local technical reasoning with rationale explaining solution choice

nodes.label: MUSE Knowledge Base
nodes.rationale: Large structured KB of 36,960 source-grounded P–S–R triplets mined from full-text scientific papers across domains

nodes.label: Modular P–S–R Extraction Pipeline
nodes.rationale: Five-stage pipeline: paragraph filtering, entity extraction, relation extraction, rationale construction, post-processing; separates local boundary-based labels from conceptual grouping

nodes.label: Rationale-Supervised LLM Training
nodes.rationale: Application: using extracted rationales as supervision signal for scientific problem solving; improves performance on complex multi-constraint problems but can harm simple ones

nodes.label: Constraint Load in Problem Complexity
nodes.rationale: Key finding: rationale supervision effectiveness depends on problem structure; beneficial when problem has multiple interacting constraints, harmful on trivial problems
